This concern implies a strong possibility that they have evaluated their risks and are prepared to settle below their perceived value of the case to minimize exposure. The comment on the memo indicates a bottom line that the defendant is aware of the weaknesses in their position, suggesting they may be amenable to a settlement potentially around the costs of litigation or below, to avoid the risk of a trial loss. Thus, estimating their bottom line at a figure that covers legal costs, say around $50,000 (this could be more if they need to account for any damages), reflects their current standing.
